It can go higher than that and even higher than 5.72, but don't be surprised if the price comes back down. Okay, as the big picture, let's get to the Daily chart. Look at some dates here. While Polkadot is up by 4% today, you can see it is still a bit of distance from the trading range ceiling. Even though the bulls on the next day pushed it back your closing closer to the 1.45, staying at around 1.37. The subsequent days. Today and the previous six days, So we started closing closer to the one point four five, staying at around 1.37. The subsequent days, the you know, today and the previous six days still isn't able to climb back to the same level. Okay, that's the part that's that's why I see it's a bit of a stretch target right now in the near term to pass this orange key level to get to the days to tell us this downtrend is going to finish. Okay. The base case now is that it's going to stay awfully above the 0.97, because that's the off credit tariff indicated level. That means by mid-March, we'll get an opportunity to see whether the confirmation will come in that this downtrend that started back in summer last year, very, very early days, even back to mid-September, actually, not summer. the price definitely was weakening during August and then eventually after the last run and got heavy rejection by the regular 4456, the price started to decline in September.
